summary: Friday 15:55 ET Week 1 pass for remaining Sunday/SNF/MNF slates. Highest-impact: Falcons start Cooper Rush with Tua and Penix out; Bowers expected out after meniscus trim, lifting Mayer; Ty Johnson listed questionable after Friday return so Cook receiving remains conditional; Odunze now Q but told reporters he plans to play; Bucs McMillan/Tucker doubtful; Mahomes expected MNF with LT Josh Simmons likely out; heat/storm watch on outdoor South games and Arrowhead wind. Board: Hampton Over 67.5 still viable if Mitchell limited; Mayer receptions 4.5 strengthened; Cook 14.5 receiving still CONDITIONAL; Loveland 54.5 remains PASS_AT_CURRENT and Odunze plan-to-play reduces vacuum; Dart rush 31.5 price already moved; Nix rush 14.5 still WATCH for Monday.

signals.source: Adam Schefter / Ian Rapoport / NFL.com / Kevin Stefanski
signals.market: ATL QB passing yards/attempts; Bijan Robinson rush volume; Drake London / Kyle Pitts receiving
signals.signal: Tua Tagovailoa (oblique) ruled out and Michael Penix Jr. (knee) already inactive. Stefanski named Cooper Rush the Week 1 starter vs Pittsburgh; undrafted Jack Strand is the backup.
signals.notes: Lowers ATL passing-volume and aDOT expectations vs a Tua/Penix baseline. Strengthens ATL skill-player Unders and Bijan rush-share investigation. Do not treat Tua or Penix as Sunday actives. Official inactives still due ~90 minutes before 1:00 ET.

signals.source: Adam Schefter / Ian Rapoport / AP / Raiders practice report
signals.market: Bowers receiving; Michael Mayer receptions/yards; Tre Tucker / Jalen Nailor targets
signals.signal: Bowers underwent a meniscus trim Tuesday and DNP Wednesday-Thursday. Schefter/Rapoport: expected to miss a game or two. Schefter later said the 1-2 week timeline is from Bowers' camp and may be optimistic. Official inactive not posted yet.
signals.notes: Board Mayer Over 4.5 receptions WATCH is strengthened if Bowers is inactive. DraftSharks: Mayer 6 targets / 4.5 catches / 49 yards in four 2025 games without Bowers. Will Brinson separately likes Mayer Over 38.5 receiving yards. Confirm Sunday inactives before treating Bowers markets as dead.

signals.source: Buffalo Bills official / Joe Brady / Joe Buscaglia
signals.signal: Brady listed Ty Johnson (hamstring) questionable after Johnson returned Friday following Wed-Thu DNPs. Brady: decision up to game time; staff trusts Johnson in a game setting without many practice reps. SI/Alex Brasky still lean unlikely to play.
signals.notes: Board Cook Over 14.5 receiving remains CONDITIONAL. Extra passing-down work for Cook only materializes if Johnson is inactive. Ray Davis / possible Frank Gore Jr. elevation also cap the vacuum. Recheck Sunday inactives and current book price before any play.

signals.source: Patrick Finley / Rome Odunze comments; Ben Johnson; Bears injury report
signals.market: Odunze receiving; Colston Loveland receiving yards
signals.signal: Odunze (calf) listed questionable after limited practices. He told reporters he feels good to go and plans to play Sunday: 'I doubt I'm questionable.' Ben Johnson earlier left the door open to sit him for long-term reasons.
signals.notes: If Odunze plays, Loveland Over 54.5 stays PASS_AT_CURRENT; the 51.5 opener value is gone and the target vacuum thesis weakens. If he sits, Loveland/Burden yards and receptions need a fresh look. Do not treat player comment as official active.

signals.source: Todd Bowles / Greg Auman / NBC Sports / Brianna Dix
signals.market: McMillan receiving; Emeka Egbuka receiving yards; Bucky Irving rush attempts
signals.signal: Bowles: Egbuka full go; McMillan (knee) and Sean Tucker (hamstring) doubtful. Skule (OL) also in the doubtful group on Friday designations.
signals.notes: McMillan receiving markets are fades pending a surprise active. Tucker doubtful concentrates Bucs RB work toward Irving if inactive. Will Brinson likes Egbuka Over 52.5 receiving yards; Adam Burke likes Irving Over 14.5 rush attempts. Chase/Higgins both full this week and trending play.

signals.source: Andy Reid / Patrick Mahomes / The Athletic
signals.market: Mahomes passing/rushing; KC OL-sensitive skill props; Bo Nix rushing yards
signals.signal: Reid: pretty good chance Mahomes starts MNF unless something comes up; Mahomes says no-limits football and will wear a brace. Separately Reid: good chance LT Josh Simmons (back) does not play; undrafted Kahlil Benson expected at LT vs Denver's front.
signals.notes: Mahomes availability is expected but first game back from ACL/LCL. Blind-side OL downgrade plus Arrowhead wind/storm chance (Covers: ~13 mph gusting 20, ~49% storm probability Friday forecast) increases sack/scramble/kicker variance. Board Nix Over 14.5 rush remains WATCH; Payton says Nix movement is back, but first live rush volume after ankle surgery is not confirmed.

signals.source: Chargers unofficial depth chart / Daniel Popper / Keaton Mitchell injury notes
signals.signal: Hampton is listed as the starting RB. Keaton Mitchell (hamstring) limited Wednesday-Thursday. McDaniel has talked three-back usage, but beat reporting still treats Hampton as the centerpiece.
signals.notes: Board ACTIVE Over 67.5 rush yards. FantasyPros liked the number higher; internal play-to 69.5. Mitchell limitation supports carry concentration, but committee language from McDaniel caps confidence. Recheck Friday/Saturday designations and do not chase past play-to.

signals.source: Action Network / Covers model / Sharp Football
signals.signal: Market moved from roughly 28.5 opener to 30.5-31.5. Covers model projects 35.5 rush yards on o31.5. Action Network shows o31.5 -111 / u31.5 -113. Sharp notes Dart's 2025 rush surplus and concussion history.
signals.notes: Board WATCH Over 31.5. Edge compressed after the move. Nabers status is a script swing: Harbaugh thinks he is ready; Nabers said playing is his call and he will not risk his career. Confirm Nabers active/snap plan Sunday.

signals.signal: Friday forecast: CHI@CAR ~88F/heat index ~94 with slight storm chance; CLE@JAX ~88-90F heat index near 100 and ~46% shower/storm chance; NYJ@TEN heat; TB@CIN warm/humid light wind. DEN@KC MNF is the wind/storm watch (~13 mph, gusts ~20, ~49% thunderstorm probability). Several 4:25 games are indoor.
signals.notes: Heat can add substitution/script variance in JAX/CAR/TEN. Do not fade Sunday passing games solely on Friday heat. Revisit JAX precip and Arrowhead wind Sunday morning / Monday afternoon.

signals.source: Kellen Moore / PFT / Saints practice report
signals.market: Alvin Kamara rush/rec; Travis Etienne rush volume
signals.signal: Kamara (MCL) listed questionable after limited practices. Moore called him Q. Estime out. Etienne is the Saints debut workhorse if Kamara is inactive or snap-limited.
signals.notes: New prop candidate: Etienne rush yards/attempts if Kamara is inactive. Do not assume full Kamara passing-down role from a Q tag.

signals.source: Will Brinson / CBS Sports; Adam Burke / VSiN
signals.signal: Brinson: Mayer Over 38.5 receiving yards after Bowers news. Burke separately likes Juwan Johnson Over 41.5 receiving yards (NO) and Bucky Irving Over 14.5 rush attempts (TB).
signals.notes: Preserve disagreement vs board preference for Mayer receptions 4.5 rather than yards. Confirm current sportsbook and juice; do not merge books.

signals.signal: Patriots placing A.J. Brown on IR for a high-ankle sprain suffered Wednesday; minimum four games. Rapoport: DaQuan Jones takes the roster spot.
signals.notes: Week 1 NE-SEA already final. Signal is for later-week NE WR volume (Doubs/Douglas/Williams), not Sunday's remaining board.
